items.title: 6.7 Enthalpy tabdeeli aur khoraak ka calorie content (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 6.7, printed pages 125-126.

blocks.text: Khoraak ko fuel ke taur par dekha ja sakta hai. Jab khoraak hazam hoti hai to us mein mehfooz kimiyai energy, jise calorie content bhi kehte hain, hararat ke taur par kharij hoti hai; hazam hona utni hi energy kharij karta hai jitni khoraak ko jism ke bahar jalana, to kul enthalpy of combustion heat of combustion ke barabar hai, jo calorimeter mein, aam taur par bomb calorimeter mein, tai ki ja sakti hai.

blocks.title: Calorie content
blocks.text: Khoraak ka calorie content us energy ka paimana hai jo jism mein khoraak ke poori tarah kharch hone par kharij hoti hai, aam taur par kilocalories (kcal) ya joules (J) mein.

blocks.prompt: Chammach bhar shakar se jism ko milne wali energy shakar ko calorimeter mein jala kar kyun napi ja sakti hai?
blocks.explanation: Hess ke qanoon se shakar aur oxygen se carbon dioxide aur pani tak enthalpy tabdeeli raste se qata-e-nazar ek jaisi hai. Hazam hona aur jalna ek hi maddon se shuru aur khatam hote hain, to woh ek jaisi energy kharij karte hain, aur calorimeter ki heat of combustion jism ke calorie content ke barabar hai.

items: Khoraak fuel hai: hazam hona combustion jitni energy kharij karta hai, jo (bomb) calorimeter mein napi jati hai; calorie content woh energy kcal ya J mein hai.
